name: Nibbly
title: Cloud Dragonling
description: A sky-blue dragonling that hums while it naps on clouds.
catchphrase: Nibbles away at technical debt one bite-sized commit at a time!

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Crunchy sweet birch bark! Beaver teeth click in industrious rhythm! 🪵🦫
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Slapping flat beaver tail on floorboard! Time to build dams! 🦫
companionPersonality.petReaction: Waddles over to deliver a neatly carved wooden pencil holder! 🦫💖

dialogue.idle: Sharpening teeth on a cedar log, chips flying everywhere. 🦫
dialogue.working: Chipping away at technical debt in tidy, manageable bite-sized PRs! 🦫⚡
dialogue.thinking: Inspecting the grain of the architecture before the first cut... 🤔
dialogue.success: TIMBER! Massive debt log brought down safely and repurposed! 🦫🎉
dialogue.error: Teeth stuck in knotty pine! Wiggling loose with a grin! 🪵
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sleeping inside a snug lodge of woven river branches... 🌙
